video.title: Catch Expiring SSL Certs Before CEO Calls
video.script: You trust Let's Encrypt to auto-renew. It works most of the time. But that one certificate, the one everyone forgot about, expires on a Sunday. Monday morning: CEO meeting. Sound familiar? Cert Watch fixes this. Paste your domains, see exactly when they expire, and get an email a month before instead of an hour after disaster. One page, no signup, runs right in your browser. Paste your domains and take 30 seconds to save yourself from the next renewal apocalypse. Link in the description.
